source: William Lilly 1647 first edition Wellcome b30338724

groups.topic: Printed CLX boundary and scope: mid-heaven directions

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CLX Directions of the Mid-heaven to PROMITTORS
claims.historical_meaning_only: First-edition CLX starts below the separate rule/divider on printed 668, not in prior CLIX.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: preferment whether publique or private
claims.historical_meaning_only: The historical technique purports to time public or private promotion; not a demonstrated method.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: some Office or Command
claims.historical_meaning_only: The author's separate targets include office and command.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: florish in his Profession and have great trading
claims.historical_meaning_only: Trade and professional flourishing are source targets, not equivalent to title.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: when losses or crosses therein
claims.historical_meaning_only: Professional and commercial setbacks are also contemplated, rather than only favorable outcomes.

groups.topic: Mid-heaven directed to body of Saturn: status and class conditions

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mid-heaven is directed to the body of Saturn
claims.historical_meaning_only: Saturn's body/conjunction is a distinct configuration, not Saturnian aspects or terms.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: wrath and indignation of Princes Magistrates Officers
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged conflict with officials and powerful authorities.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: subverts the Natives honour his commands
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged loss of honors/command is distinct from economic loss.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: favours and Offices of trust he formerly had
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged withdrawal of earlier patronage and positions of trust.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: performs his matters with remissnesse
claims.historical_meaning_only: A claim about diminished diligence accompanies this configuration.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: scurvie and ungodly actions
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historical moralizing label only; not a permissible moral judgment on a person.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: his Servants are sturdy
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claims disputes with servants, historically class-bound language.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: sometimes death happens by the sentence of a Judge
claims.historical_meaning_only: Death/sentence assertion is a historical high-stakes claim, not clinical/legal forecast.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: understood when a violent death was portended
claims.historical_meaning_only: The judicial death clause explicitly presupposes a separate natal violent-death indication.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if he be a King or Prince
claims.historical_meaning_only: King/prince consequences are conditional on social position and cannot be generalized.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: beware his Subjects rise not against him
claims.historical_meaning_only: For monarchs the source alleges possible uprising.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Landlord or Noble-man ... Tenants
claims.historical_meaning_only: For landowners the source alleges tenants conspiring; not a universal Saturn outcome.

groups.topic: Saturn sextile or trine: elder patrons, land, and magistracy

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the sextile or trine of Saturn
claims.historical_meaning_only: Both favorable aspects are distinct from Saturn's body and adverse aspects.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Honour or Esteem by meanes of aged Saturnine persons
claims.historical_meaning_only: Esteem through elders is the alleged mechanism.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: more sober grave and advised then formerly
claims.historical_meaning_only: Changed demeanor appears separately from office.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lands Houses Orchards Gardens Woods
claims.historical_meaning_only: Land and property dealing is an alleged economic mechanism.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: accumulate Wealth thereby
claims.historical_meaning_only: Property-related gain, not an unconditional money claim.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if Saturn be in an earthly Signe
claims.historical_meaning_only: Confidence in the property claim is explicitly modified by Saturn's earth sign.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: in Taurus or Capricorn
claims.historical_meaning_only: Original text specifies Taurus or Capricorn examples; exact third-sign omission preserved.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: command in the Common-wealth viz Magistracy
claims.historical_meaning_only: Office in civic government is an additional alleged target.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: respected more then usuall with his Equals
claims.historical_meaning_only: Reputation among peers is distinct from formal office.

groups.topic: Saturn square or opposition: adverse class-specific effects

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the square or opposition of Saturn
claims.historical_meaning_only: Both aspects are adverse in source, not interchangeable with sextile/trine.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: laborious difficult and unfortunate Mischances
claims.historical_meaning_only: The passage alleges broadly difficult circumstances.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: deprives ... Honour Office Magistracy Employment
claims.historical_meaning_only: Loss of office/employment/honors are separately named.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or Reputation
claims.historical_meaning_only: Reputational loss is distinct from position loss.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturnine and vulgar persons ... Husbandmen Colliers Day-labourers
claims.historical_meaning_only: The alleged opponents are described using period occupational class stereotypes.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: unto vulgar persons Beggery Poverty Disgrace
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period class-dependent threat of poverty and disgrace, not any person's fate.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: People discredit accusations and trecherous Informations
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claims slander and accusation as a mechanism.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: damage by Thefts
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claims economic loss by theft.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: King or Prince ... breach of Leagues with his Allies
claims.historical_meaning_only: Only for monarchs, alleged alliances breaking.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Tumults in his Dominions
claims.historical_meaning_only: Conditional alleged civil disturbances.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: discontented Commonalty ... Privy-Counsell
claims.historical_meaning_only: Conditional alleged conflict with people and advisers.

groups.topic: Saturn terms: opposition by old men and melancholic thoughts

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the Terme of Saturn
claims.historical_meaning_only: Planetary term direction treated independently of conjunction/aspects.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Old men and men of sordid Dispositions
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historic class/moral language for asserted detractors.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: stirres them up with a desire to ruine
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged interpersonal threats, not actionable danger forecasts.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: multiplicity of melancholy Thoughts
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period psychological description, not a diagnosis.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: perplexed to maintaine his former Estimation
claims.historical_meaning_only: Anxiety over social standing distinguished from actual office loss.

groups.topic: Mid-heaven to Jupiter body: patronage and social-rank adaptations

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Medium-Coeli to the Body of Jupiter
claims.historical_meaning_only: Conjunction/body of Jupiter, a new subsection beginning printed 669.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: wholsome profitable and glorious yeer
claims.historical_meaning_only: Favorable rhetoric is historical assertion, not measured outcome.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: preferred to Dignity and Honour
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged public promotion.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: favour bounty and patronage of some great Person
claims.historical_meaning_only: Benefit attributed to a high-status patron, occasionally clergy/lawyer.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: worldly Honour and Wealth attending it
claims.historical_meaning_only: Wealth is related yet independent alleged effect.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: every one Preferment according to capacity
claims.historical_meaning_only: The source explicitly modifies elevation by existing social capacity.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Student in Law or Divinity ... Practice
claims.historical_meaning_only: For law/theology students the source predicts career practice.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Office or Benefice
claims.historical_meaning_only: For same students positions/benefices are a separate target.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Country-man ... Church-warden
claims.historical_meaning_only: For ordinary parishioner source supplies small-scale church office.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: King or Prince ... renewing of Leagues
claims.historical_meaning_only: For royalty source names diplomacy, distinct from individual office.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: accesse to a Kingdome
claims.historical_meaning_only: Succession/realm elevation is monarch-specific.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: calling a Parliament or a generall Counsell
claims.historical_meaning_only: Governing deliberation is another monarch-specific alleged effect.

groups.topic: Jupiter sextile/trine: stronger radix and embassies

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the sextile or trine of Jupiter
claims.historical_meaning_only: Separately named favorable aspects.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: same promised by the conjunction
claims.historical_meaning_only: Effects borrow prior Jupiter-body clause context rather than standalone catch-all.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if Jupiter in the Radix be strong
claims.historical_meaning_only: Additional natal-strength precondition for unusually strong advancement.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: even from the Dunghil to some good Preferment
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period language for alleged steep class mobility.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Office Dignity Preferment
claims.historical_meaning_only: Public appointments named conditional upon the prior configuration.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: to Princes accesse of Embassadours
claims.historical_meaning_only: Diplomatic role stated for the princely class.

groups.topic: Jupiter square/opposition and terms: legal pressure and support

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the square or opposition of Jupiter
claims.historical_meaning_only: Adverse Jupiter aspects are independently described.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Grievances occasioned by the Law ... Judgments
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historically asserted legal difficulties.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Judges Lawyers Gentlemen Magistrates ... envious
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged attacks from prominent legal and official figures.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: but to no purpose for they may not prevaile
claims.historical_meaning_only: The text explicitly says attempts to remove an office are unsuccessful; do not omit.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: afflictions ... by meanes of the Clergy
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period religious stereotype and conflict.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: spend some part of his Estate to defend himselfe
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged defense expenses separate from legal outcome.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: detriment in fortune by ... Kindred
claims.historical_meaning_only: Another alleged economic mechanism.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: King or Prince ... abridging their priviledges
claims.historical_meaning_only: Period political consequence conditional on ruling class.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the Termes of Jupiter
claims.historical_meaning_only: Planetary term is a distinct condition from adverse Jupiter aspects.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Prosperity and health of body
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historical medical claim only; no real-person clinical predictions.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: furtherance in all his Occasions ... thrive in his Office
claims.historical_meaning_only: Asserted support through gentry/clergy and office advancement.
